**Topographer** — a homelab network + hardware topology dashboard.
Scanners and collectors map your machines and your LAN from live sources (UniFi, Proxmox, OPNsense, SNMP, Tailscale, Docker, ping/ARP), a pipeline normalizes and enriches the result — vendor lookup, VLAN by subnet, device kind — and the dashboard draws it live in the browser. Reporting agents on other hosts push their own hardware map plus CPU / network / disk telemetry back to one server, so the whole fleet is visible from a single page. Per-service widgets (Pi-hole, Proxmox, the *arr stack, and 150+ more) and live Glances metrics sit alongside the maps.
Everything is stdlib Python with a single dependency (PyYAML). Your topology is treated as private data: it stays in appdata and is never sent anywhere.
Maintained by FugginOld. Issues and feature requests are welcome on GitHub.
